_doc: Independent reference oracle, VERDICT kind. Asserts RealPropertyTitleValidityCheck's title_verdict for the three registration states the Land Registration Act 2002 and the Land Registration Rules 2003 decide on their face. Statute text verified on legislation.gov.uk on sourced_at. Not asserted, deliberately: TitleConditionallyValid (unregistered title) — that label is the rule's own classification of title deduced from deeds, not a statutory category.
statute: Land Registration Act 2002 s.27(1) (registrable dispositions do not operate at law until registered) + s.58(1) (conclusiveness of the register); Land Registration Rules 2003 r.4(1) (title number)

cases.label: registered-with-title-number
cases.citation_quote: If, on the entry of a person in the register as the proprietor of a legal estate, the legal estate would not otherwise be vested in him, it shall be deemed to be vested in him as a result of the registration.
cases.note: Entered on the register under a title number: the legal estate is vested by registration.

cases.label: registration-pending
cases.citation_quote: If a disposition of a registered estate or registered charge is required to be completed by registration, it does not operate at law until the relevant registration requirements are met.
cases.note: Application lodged but not completed: the disposition does not yet operate at law.

cases.label: registered-without-title-number
cases.citation_quote: Each individual register must have a distinguishing number, or series of letters and numbers, known as the title number.
cases.note: A record claiming registration with no title number contradicts r.4(1); the claim cannot be a registered title.
